snippet.title: Secrets of Velendar   Escape Room Trailer
snippet.description:
Find your way out of Velendar Castle. Discover why everything was taken from you. In this fantasy Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to escape the wrath of the king… and find out what he wants from you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4016880/Secrets_of_Velendar_Castle__Escape_Room/
